gamerule.lightbound.minimum_light.descri: Minimum light needed to support a player (1-15). At 1, only complete darkness is intangible.
gamerule.lightbound.afterglow_ticks.desc: How long a trail of player-carried light remains. 20 ticks is one second; 0 disables afterglow.
gamerule.lightbound.heartbeat_period_tic: Time between repeating light blackouts. 20 ticks is one second; 0 disables heartbeat light.
gamerule.lightbound.heartbeat_dark_ticks: Dark time within each heartbeat, limited to the heartbeat period.
gamerule.lightbound.dark_swimming.descri: Allow players to swim through dark, intangible terrain.
gamerule.lightbound.void_loop.descriptio: Loop players above the world after they fall into the void.
lightbound.settings.title: Uncommon Nights
lightbound.gameplay.title: Gameplay
lightbound.gameplay.threshold.tooltip: Minimum light that supports players, from 1 to 15. At 1, only complete darkness is intangible.
lightbound.gameplay.afterglow.tooltip: Keep a short trail of carried light after moving away or putting the item away. Off restores immediate darkness.
lightbound.gameplay.heartbeat.tooltip: Pulse carried light and its afterglow with a repeating blackout. Enabled edge glow pulses before darkness; placed lights and daylight keep working.
lightbound.gameplay.blackout.tooltip: Duration of darkness in each heartbeat, up to the full period.
lightbound.gameplay.swimming.tooltip: Allow swimming through dark, intangible terrain.
lightbound.gameplay.voidLoop.tooltip: Loop back above the world after falling into the void.
lightbound.experimental.title: Experimental visuals
lightbound.settings.gatewayVoid.tooltip: Replace the dark void with a continuous rainbow starfield that changes color very slowly. Dark terrain stays intangible.
lightbound.settings.dynamicLighting.tool: Light the world with held torches and other glowing items. Visual only; the server still decides where you can stand.
lightbound.settings.binaryLighting.toolt: Give lit areas a comfortable, uniform brightness. Light levels still decide the void boundary.
lightbound.settings.litBrightness.toolti: Brightness of visible terrain with uniform lighting enabled.
lightbound.settings.edgeGlow.tooltip: Highlight the real boundary between solid ground and the dark void.
lightbound.settings.glowStrength.tooltip: Intensity of the glowing boundary and aura sparks.
lightbound.settings.glowColor.tooltip: Choose the RGB color of the boundary glow and aura particles.
lightbound.settings.auraParticles.toolti: Let small glowing sparks drift along the void boundary.
lightbound.settings.particleDensity.tool: Amount of aura sparks. Lower values reduce visual clutter and rendering work.
lightbound.gameplay.mineUnlit.tooltip: Allow mining below the server light threshold. Off requires real light, including held light and afterglow.
